The processing pipeline is a [`targets`](https://books.ropensci.org/targets/)
graph (decision 0004) — the single source of truth for how raw data becomes
features, models, and results. The map below is **generated from the graph**, so
it can't drift from what the code actually does.

## Stages

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  ingest[ingest\nCFBD + nflverse] --> clean[clean\nstandardize + coerce keys]
  clean --> link[link\nplayer-season backbone + joins]
  link --> features[features\nlongitudinal change]
  features --> model[model\nexplain + predict]
  model --> report[report\nsite + viz]
  clean -.-> contracts[(data contracts)]
  clean -.-> audit[(audit log)]
  link -.-> audit
  features -.-> audit
```

`/roster` is now ingested, keyed on an authoritative `season` (stamped from the
queried year — the endpoint's own `year` is the eligibility class). But roster
**weight is static per player**, so the decision-0003 between-season
`weight_delta` is not derivable and was dropped; we keep the static roster
`weight`. The `model` and `report` stages are wired placeholders. Post-draft
**NFL outcomes** (nflverse) are now ingested and bridged to picks by draft slot,
but as *labels* — they stay off the model input path to avoid leakage (decision
0014).
:::
